MANDARIN MARCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MANDARIN MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Details, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Details.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Details.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Details.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Details.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Functional Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.

6. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Word Classes.

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

11. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 3.4.1 Word Classes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public Speaking ● Vocabulary development ● Clarity  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading Fluency ● Articulation ● Pronunciation ● Intonation ● Phra and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Functional Writing ● Posters and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1 Functional Writing Curriculum Vitae and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 5.4.1 Word Classes ● The modal verb 想 S+ 想 + V+ Object ● The auxiliary v and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
